package.name: nav2_controller_common
package.description: Standalone PID controller math library (no ROS dependencies). Provides PIDController (default integral hold), PIDBCController (backward-calculation anti-windup) and PIDICController (integral-clamping anti-windup), plus the PidConf configuration struct. Ported from dcm_navigation for use as a reusable ament_cmake library in mobile_navigation controllers.
